methodologyNotes: Published self-serve consumer pricing was collected from each carrier's own pricing page on the accessed date; where the official page returned a 403/429 or rendered prices behind JavaScript, the figures were corroborated against dedicated 2026 carrier-pricing review sources (WhistleOut, yournavi.com, Droid-Life). All prices are per-month single-line USD with the standard AutoPay discount applied where the carrier advertises that as the headline rate; multi-line and limited-time promotional/intro rates are noted in each plan's notes rather than as the headline figure. Minutes/calls/overage fields are null because every plan in this vertical includes unlimited talk and text; there are no quote-only tiers in self-serve consumer mobile, so no monthlyUsd values are null.

vendors.name: Verizon
vendors.provenance: https://www.verizon.com/plans/unlimited/ (official myPlan postpaid unlimited pricing page; prices shown with Auto Pay)

plans.name: Unlimited Welcome
plans.notes: Single line with Auto Pay. Unlimited talk/text/data on 5G, no mobile hotspot, Mexico/Canada talk/text/data. Multi-line price drops to $55/line for 4 lines with offer credit.

plans.name: Unlimited Plus
plans.notes: Single line with Auto Pay. Unlimited premium data on 5G Ultra Wideband, 30GB premium mobile hotspot, up to 50% off one device plan. $55/line for 4 lines with offer credit.

plans.name: Unlimited Ultimate
plans.notes: Single line with Auto Pay. Unlimited premium data, unlimited hotspot (200GB at full speed then 6 Mbps), 4K streaming, unlimited international data/talk/text, Global Choice. $55/line for 4 lines with offer credit.
